title: Quintessentially Yeasty Greek Dough Loukoumades
description: A traditional Greek dessert featuring crispy, yeasty dough balls drizzled with a sweet honey syrup and sprinkled with turmeric, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this version incorporates wok-hei for a smoky flavor and is Jain-friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, turmeric, and salt.
Gradually add the sugar and water to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Heat the wok-hei oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Once the oil is hot, use a spoon to drop small balls of the dough into the oil, being careful not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the dough balls until they are golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Remove the loukoumades from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Drizzle the honey over the loukoumades and serve immediately.
